articles.title_en: Russian strikes on Kyiv and the surrounding region kill three, including a child, and wound seven
articles.lead_en: Russian forces continued to strike Kyiv with drones and various types of missiles. An attack early on September 30 killed two people and injured four in Kyiv, the city administration said.
